module.title: ideal MHD and hydrodynamic finite-volume solver (Riemann solvers, reconstruction, divergence control, time stepping)
module.expensive_path: the explicit block loop of advance_expl: face-value reconstruction (TVD, MP5 and the 5th-order schemes in ModFaceValue), the Riemann solvers in ModFaceFlux (Rusanov, Linde, HLLD, Roe, Godunov exact), the source terms and conservative update over every 8^3 (or 64x4x1) block, then the ghost-cell message pass in BATL; the Brio-Wu, fast-wave and Kelvin-Helmholtz runs spend more than 95 percent of wall time there
module.rationale: one module owns the single-fluid ideal MHD and hydrodynamic core that every other configuration builds on: the Riemann solvers, the reconstruction and limiters, the three divergence-B strategies (eight-wave, hyperbolic cleaning, constrained transport and projection), Boris semi-relativistic correction, the conservative versus non-conservative energy switch, and the explicit, partially steady, local and time-warp time-stepping variants; the official shock-tube, wave and instability tests exercise exactly this code on generic Cartesian, round-cube and cylindrical grids without a planet
excluded: non-ideal terms and implicit solvers (Hall, resistive, viscous, conductive: the non-ideal module)
multi-fluid and five-moment equation sets (the multifluid module)
planet-specific boundaries, dipoles and couplings (the geospace and planetary modules)
the OpenACC GPU port of ModUpdateStateFast (no nvfortran in the pinned build; the tests named *_gpu run the same code on CPU with -noacc)
hazards: every official test reconfigures the compile-time block size and equation set with Config.pl and rebuilds BATSRUS.exe (30 to 50 s per test on 12 cores), so each check carries its own build
the shock-tube outputs are formatted ASCII IDL .out files written by PostIDL from per-processor .idl pieces; upstream compares them with DiffNum.pl at 1e-5 relative, 1e-11 absolute
results were measured independent of the MPI rank count (1, 2, 4 ranks agree to 1e-12) and bit-identical on rerun for the Brio-Wu tube
